name: MonarchSkeleton
title: Skeleton
summary: A loading placeholder in the shape of a line of text, a block or a circle, with a shimmer that stands still when animations are off.
whenToUse: While the content of a card, a row or a screen loads and its layout is known: show placeholders in the places the text and pictures will take.
whenNotToUse: For a wait whose layout is unknown, or inside a button, use MonarchProgress or MonarchButton(loading = true). For a failure, use MonarchErrorState or MonarchInlineErrorRetry.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSkeleton(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, shape: MonarchSkeletonShape = MonarchSkeletonShape.Rect)
enum class MonarchSkeletonShape { Text, Rect, Circle }

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the placeholder. Set a width for lines and blocks, and Modifier.size for circles.

options.name: shape
options.description: Text: a line three quarters of the body font size high, 4dp corners. Rect: at least 40dp high, 8dp corners. Circle: 40dp unless Modifier.size sets another size.

states.name: loading
states.description: A lighter band sweeps across the muted fill every 1.6 seconds, from the start edge to the end edge.

states.name: still
states.description: With animations turned off the placeholder is the muted fill and does not move.

appearance: The muted background with a band of the subtle background sweeping across it, in every theme. In the high-contrast themes the two roles are close, so the band is faint and the shape carries the meaning.
platformNotes: The web Skeleton pulses its opacity; Monarch never dims with alpha, so on Android a gradient band sweeps across the fill, as the plan asked. The sweep follows the layout direction. The web width and height props are the modifier here. iOS covers skeletons with the system redaction (redacted(reason: .placeholder)) and ships no type; Compose has no redaction, so Android builds this component.
accessibility: A skeleton is hidden from TalkBack. Give the region that holds the placeholders a content description such as "Loading contact", and say when it has loaded.
The shimmer stands still when the user has turned animations off.
The text line grows with the font size setting, so placeholders match the text that replaces them.
edgeCases: A block or a circle without a size from the modifier takes its 40dp default; a block also fills the width it is given.
A parent that measures with unbounded width, such as a horizontally scrolling row, needs a width on text lines and blocks.
